title: Per-commit structural manifests in review
description:
sutra_review collapses a branch to a single diff. For long branches where per-commit intent matters, agents lose the "why was this split into separate commits" structure.

Add an optional mode or tool that, given a commit range, returns a per-commit manifest: files changed, symbols affected, change classification (added/modified/deleted/renamed), and optionally convention/constraint violations per commit.

Lower priority than single-diff improvements (sutra/112). Most agent workflows work on branch-level diffs. Useful for multi-commit branch review and understanding how a file evolved.

Replaces old task: sutra/needs-designing/13.

acceptance_criteria.text: New MCP tool `sutra_commit_manifest` accepts workspace + commit range (base/head, defaulting to branch range)
Returns an array of per-commit entries, each with: hash, subject, author, timestamp, changed files
Each changed file entry includes symbol-level change classification using existing ChangeKind taxonomy (Added, Deleted, SignatureChanged, BodyChanged) with callee diffs
Merge commits are skipped (only first-parent commits included)
Requires analysis tier (same gating as diff_impact and review)
Graceful degradation: files in unsupported languages get file-level entry with no symbol_changes
Cap on commits processed (e.g. 50) with a truncated flag when exceeded

execution_record: Implemented as planned in 4 steps. No divergence from plan. All 392 existing tests pass. New tool is ~80 lines (commit_manifest.rs) plus ~47 lines (git_list_commits in git.rs) plus MCP/help wiring. Reuses symbol_diff::diff_file for change classification as planned."

messages.author: agent
messages.text: Codex review: needs-attention → fixed. Two findings:\n1. Merge commits included despite --first-parent (added --no-merges) — d818139\n2. Silent error swallowing via unwrap_or_default() on git_diff_files (now surfaces diff_error field per commit) — d818139"
